title: Landing page
request: Add a one-page landing page for the habit tracker.

features.title: One-page landing page
features.story: As a visitor I can see in a few seconds what the app does and how to start.
acceptance: The page has a headline that says what the app does, and a button labelled Get started.
The page lists three benefits, each with a short heading and one sentence.
On a phone the page is one column, the text is easy to read and nothing runs off the screen.
On a desktop the three benefits sit side by side.

results.evidence: Three benefits, each with a heading.
The phone picture shows one column.
No picture was opened by the second AI.

features.title: Contact page
features.story: As a visitor I can find how to reach the team.
acceptance: The contact page shows an email address.
